tasks.short: Advise court participants about conduct, issues and proceedings

steps.what: Consult the actual case record and applicable procedural text when the participant's question requires it
inputs: actual participant question and case identity
existing case record and authoritative procedural text
outputs: judge-read case and procedure information relevant to the question

steps.what: Advise attorneys, juries, litigants or court personnel on the actual conduct, issue or proceeding and respond to their questions
inputs: judge-read case and procedure information relevant to the question
participants' actual questions and circumstances
outputs: actual judicial explanation and participant discussion

tasks.design: Configure a native case-and-procedure reference view in {OTHER}, the court case-management and legal-reference systems. It shortens access to existing text; the judge reads it and gives the explanation directly, without a model interpreting the law for the participants.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant case and procedure information can require repeated navigation during questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case links and reference bookmarks can expose the actual source text.
tasks.still_hard: Fair explanation requires context, impartiality and attention to each participant's understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Explain procedure clearly while preserving the judge's impartial role.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for court access and approved reference configuration

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native court-case links and legal-reference views can shorten source access while judicial explanation remains human.

assumptions: Provisional shares are not observed baselines. The focal role is a judge in a court, not an employee exercising judicial power inside a company.
OTHER means court case management and authoritative legal references. Existing court staff/source publishers maintain the record and text; missing information requires normal inquiry.
Only source navigation changes. The actual conversation remains fully retained; this statement does not establish a separate written report or message.
Gross provisional saving 1 minus 0.25 hour of reference-link upkeep gives 0.75 net; existing equivalent links remove it.
unknowns: Current source navigation and approved court configuration
research_questions: Do actual participant questions require repeated navigation that native references can remove?

already_counted.description: Read the retrieved case and procedure information

incremental.description: Check reference bookmarks and case-view links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 0.75%; discussion and impartial explanation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research legal issues and write judicial opinions

steps.what: Research the actual legal issues in authoritative legislation, decisions and commentary and read the relevant case record
inputs: actual legal issues and case record
authoritative legal-source texts
outputs: judge-read legal authorities and case evidence

steps.what: Determine the legal analysis and conclusions supported by the actual authorities and case facts
inputs: judge-read legal authorities and case evidence
actual questions requiring an opinion

steps.what: Write the opinion and check its reasoning, quotations, citations and consistency with the actual record
inputs: judge's legal analysis and conclusions
judge-read legal authorities and case evidence
existing opinion document format

steps.what: Save the completed checked opinion in the existing court document workspace
inputs: complete checked judicial opinion version

tasks.design: Configure native source bookmarks in {OTHER} and the existing opinion template and verified citation insertion in {DOCS}. The judge researches, reasons and writes the opinion; only repeated navigation and fixed formatting change before the checked version is saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and fixed citation/document formatting can interrupt substantive opinion writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native legal-reference links and document fields can reuse actual selected references.
tasks.still_hard: Authority selection, application to facts and reasoning remain judicial work.
tasks.human_edge: Reach and explain a defensible conclusion with independent judgment.

ambition.what: No automatic opinion or case outcome proposed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for court approval, source licences and case access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native legal-source links and citation/document fields can reduce navigation and formatting without generating judicial reasoning.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured. OTHER means authoritative legal research and case-management systems.
Existing source publishers supply the legal text and identifiers; the judge selects and reads the actual authorities in s1. Missing citations are resolved manually rather than generated.
The change uses no model to apply law to facts or draft the reasoning. Existing equivalent template and research views remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 5.2 minus 0.7 hour of reference/template upkeep gives 4.5 net; same-system save is negligible and fully retained.
This writing task ends with the checked document; no publication or legal issuance is proposed or credited as a saving.
research_questions: Which actual opinion-writing navigation and formatting actions remain manual today?

already_counted.description: Read authorities and write/check the substantive opinion

incremental.description: Maintain reference links, opinion fields and citation-format settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 4.5%; substantive legal research, judgment and writing stay with the judge.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret and enforce procedural rules or establish necessary procedures

steps.what: Read the actual procedural question, case context and applicable enacted rules or established procedures
inputs: actual procedural issue and case record
authoritative procedural rules and existing court procedures
outputs: judge-read procedural authorities and actual case context

steps.what: Interpret the rules and decide how to enforce them or establish a procedure where none is prescribed
inputs: judge-read procedural authorities and actual case context

steps.what: Direct the actual proceedings, explain the procedural ruling and address compliance or questions as they arise
inputs: judge's procedural decision and reasons
actual participants and their conduct in the proceeding
outputs: actual procedural directions and observed compliance issues

steps.what: Complete and check the actual procedural order or rule text where the matter requires a written instrument
inputs: judge's procedural decision and reasons
actual procedural directions and observed compliance issues

steps.what: Commit the completed checked procedural instrument to the court record
inputs: complete checked procedural instrument version

tasks.design: Configure direct native links from the case record to the relevant procedural texts in {OTHER}, the court case and reference systems. The judge interprets and enforces the procedure, conducts the proceeding and completes any actual written instrument before its separate court-record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedural source text can require repeated navigation from a case record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference links can expose actual rules without recommending a ruling.
tasks.still_hard: Procedural fairness and a gap in established rules require judicial judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt lawful procedure to the actual dispute while protecting participants' rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct procedural-reference links can reduce source navigation while judicial interpretation, enforcement and rule formation remain human.

assumptions: This is an unmeasured scenario with an actual written procedural instrument; an oral-only matter has no invented paperwork baseline or saving.
OTHER means court case management and authoritative procedural references. Court staff/publishers maintain existing records and texts.
Only lookup navigation changes; directions, decision and writing remain fully retained. Missing or conflicting sources require judicial investigation.
Gross provisional saving 2 minus 0.5 hour of reference-link upkeep gives 1.5 net. Existing equivalent links remove it.
The commit uses the completed checked text; no automatic external notice, new rule or sanction is proposed.
unknowns: Actual written-instrument ownership and current procedural-reference access
research_questions: Do real procedural questions require repeated navigation that native case links can shorten?

already_counted.description: Read actual procedural authorities and case context

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.5%; no reduction in procedural judgment, hearings or written directions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess applications and issue arrest warrants

steps.what: Read the actual arrest-warrant application and its supporting evidence and confirm the case and person identifiers
inputs: actual arrest-warrant application and supporting evidence
existing court case and applicant-supplied person identifiers
outputs: judge-read warrant evidence and checked identifiers

steps.what: Determine whether the actual application satisfies the applicable conditions and whether the arrest warrant should issue
inputs: judge-read warrant evidence and checked identifiers
applicable authoritative warrant requirements
outputs: judge's actual warrant decision and permitted terms

steps.what: Complete the arrest-warrant instrument and check every identifier, authorised term and intended issuance destination against the actual decision
inputs: judge's actual warrant decision and permitted terms
judge-read warrant evidence and checked identifiers
existing warrant form
outputs: complete checked arrest-warrant version and issuance destination

steps.what: Issue the exact completed and checked arrest warrant through the authorised court mechanism
inputs: complete checked arrest-warrant version and issuance destination

tasks.design: Configure native application/evidence views and verified identifier prefill in {OTHER}, the court case and warrant system. The judge reads the evidence, makes the warrant decision and checks the finished instrument before personally issuing that exact version through the authorised mechanism.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence navigation and repeat entry of actual case/person identifiers can accompany warrant processing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and form prefill can reuse existing verified records without making the decision.
tasks.still_hard: The evidence and conditions for restricting liberty require independent judicial assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Determine whether an arrest warrant is justified and what its lawful terms must be.

ambition.what: No automatic warrant decision or issuance proposed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for court authorisation and restricted warrant-system access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native court form prefill can reuse actual identifiers while warrant assessment and issuance remain human-controlled.

assumptions: Shares are an unmeasured application-to-issuance scenario and exclude applicant or enforcement labour.
OTHER means court case and warrant systems. The actual applicant supplies evidence and identifiers; the judge checks them in s1. Missing or inconsistent identity data stop issuance.
Only source navigation and fixed verified identifier entry change. No model assesses evidence, recommends arrest or generates the decision.
Gross provisional saving 2.7 minus 0.7 hour of form/reference upkeep gives 2 net; existing equivalent prefill and views remove it.
The exact completed warrant and destination are checked before issuance; any edit invalidates that gate. The issuance action is fully retained and earns no saving.
unknowns: Current native warrant form fields and authorised workflow
research_questions: Which verified identifiers and evidence links still require repeated entry/navigation in actual warrant work?

already_counted.description: Read evidence and complete/check the warrant instrument

incremental.description: Check form-field mappings and restricted case-reference links

approvals.approved_version: complete checked arrest-warrant version and issuance destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2%; evidence assessment and issuance stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
